honest_c3: C1 — Single prompt "안녕" (BG-Q most-favorable; 8x larger drift than prompts 2/3/5). Crossover localized only for this prompt; other prompts may cross at different magnitudes or never cross.
C2 — Mac CPU fp32 single-substrate. Crossover position depends on phi_star pairwise-cosine numerics; alternative substrates / dtype may shift the crossover by a small amount.

C3 — BG-W helper sister-import; if BG-W helper is concurrently modified the build_states_canonical_mag and _forward_with_states semantics may drift from documented BG-W run. We carry the BG-W rows verbatim from its committed verdict.json; race risk applies only to the new sub-sweep rows.

C4 — Crossover localized only at tested magnitudes {15, 20, 25, 30, 40}. Actual crossover may sit BETWEEN tested points (e.g. between 10 and 15, or between 15 and 20). The reported crossover is an upper bound at 5-unit resolution.

C5 — F1 threshold 0.01 is anima-canonical heuristic per BG-Q spec, not cross-validated. The crossover position has meaning only relative to that threshold; a different threshold (e.g. 0.005 or 0.02) would yield a different crossover magnitude.
